[LFAC.8.4] The in-process callback surface delivers fact
instances as typed in-memory values per [LFST.2.1];
protobuf is the cross-boundary serialisation form. A
callback receiver may itself encode to protobuf (using
the schema's `.proto` from the artefact) when forwarding
cross-boundary, but the runtime does not protobuf-encode
for in-process delivery.
